none: PAS LIN-9486F6: Silver Roman finger ring inscribed 'TOT'
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver finger ring, Henig Type XI. The ring has broad shoulders, flat rectangular bezel and a deep channel running inside at either edge. The bezel is decorated with an incised rectangular linear border containing incised diagonal lines. Inside the border are the letters TOT.
